concept_title: 보랏빛 달밤의 매화 무대, 뱀과 렌
revision_note: V1 (2ac3ad0) rejected by the owner: too many borders. V2 (73a2823) merged the sky, both lattice doors and the moon/cloud layer into one back plate, shrank the clear rim 2.5 -> 1.0 mm and rendered clear acrylic see-through in the assembly preview. V3 (657a484) recomposed the scene but the owner prefers V2 ("v2가 낫다고 한거야"). V4 (a2a83cd) = V2 plus two owner requests: the blossom tree printed diagonally into the back panel and Len "seated" by cropping her raster at the seat line (0.63 of the figure height). V5 (7459c7f) restructured the scene (Len whole on a 70 mm serpent's coil, the tree back as a cut plate) and the owner rejected it ("이거 아니야 v4에서 잘림 문제만 해결하고 나무를 예시 이미지처럼 대각선 배치 해달라고"): V5 is not what he wants; go back to V4 and change only two things. V6 = V4 with exactly those two changes; every other piece, position, scale, slot, tab and rim is V4's. (1) Len's whole 84 mm figure is shown, no crop: both boots and the sword are present, the boot rims rest on the base line and the plate is carried by the bud-guard clear riser inside the tab window between the legs; the serpent stays at its V4 position and scale (its coil ends at x=138, z=8-21 and cannot reach her hips at x=152-170, z=33 without a major reshape, so she is not moved onto it). (2) The tree is still printed on the back panel (no cut path, no rim, no slot, no canopy fill) but placed like the concept (08): V4's builder applied rotate_deg counter-clockwise although it was configured and documented as clockwise, so V4's tree stood with its trunk base right of centre and its canopy mass to the left - the mirror of the concept's lower-left-to-upper-right diagonal. V6 fixes the sign (positive = clockwise) and uses 35 deg clockwise at 100 mm art (V4: 80 mm), box top-left at sky (21.3, 8.0) mm: the trunk base hides behind the serpent's back at x~130, the canopy rises to the upper right across the moon and past Len's head to the right door, the apex sits 8 mm below the sky top (no flat cut) and the lower 18 mm of the rotated box falls below the base line (hidden behind base and serpent).

finished_size_mm.note: 3T: base 3 + back panel 90 art + 1.0 mm rim = 94; whole Len assembles to 88 mm (3 + 84 art + 1 rim).

clear_border_rationale: docs/laser-cut-quality.md fixes no rim minimum; its hard limits are the 0.035 mm curve deviation and the 12 mm load-path floor on the buffered silhouette. 1.0 mm is the smallest round offset that still keeps UV ink 0.5 mm inside the cut edge under a 0.5 mm print registration error. V6 has no exception: the blossom tree is printed inside the back panel (V4 approach), so every rim is 1.0 mm.

overlays.note: left lattice door butted against the sky's left edge, bottoms aligned
right lattice door butted against the sky's right edge, bottoms aligned
moon and both cloud islands (including V1's unused 34 x 6.9 mm upper-right cloud) registered over the sky as in V2/V4

V6 owner request (tree like the concept): still printed on the back panel like V4, no cut path, no rim, no slot - but leaning the right way and larger. 100 mm art (unrotated alpha box 1283 x 990 px = 251 ppi source density, embedded at native pixels under the 300 ppi cap) rotated 35 deg CLOCKWISE at native resolution (V4's builder applied its configured 'clockwise' angle counter-clockwise, so V4's tree leaned the wrong way: trunk base right of centre, canopy mass to the left). Rotated box 120.2 x 100.4 mm with its top-left at sky (21.3, 8.0) mm = scene x 92.0, z 82: trunk base at x~130 hidden behind the serpent's back (row 23), canopy rising to the upper right across the moon (centre x 139, z 55) and past Len's head to the right door; apex 8 mm below the sky top so nothing is cut flat at the top, the thin right branch tip (2.9 mm) is clipped by the sky's right edge and the lower 18.4 mm of the box (trunk base) falls below the base line, hidden behind the base and the serpent.

pieces.note: V4 position and scale unchanged (55 mm at x=115, row 23). Not bent or moved: its coil ends at x=138, z=8-21 and cannot reach Len's hips (x=152-170, z=33) without a major reshape, which the owner did not ask for.

V6 owner request (fix the cropping): the whole 84 mm figure at V4's scale, x and row - no crop_below_fraction. Her long leg's boot sole is the lowest ink, so both boot rims rest on the base line 1.0 mm (rim) above the base top, the sword tip 3 mm above it and the hips (crotch line) 33 mm above it; the pose (one leg hanging to the base, one knee raised, sword down-left) reads as seated on the base edge. The tab under the art centre sits between the two boots where the buffered silhouette is narrower than the 12 mm load-path floor, so the bud guard raises a 12.25 mm clear riser inside the tab window from the base line up to where the legs close (about 9 mm); it is the only clear support and carries no print.

front_view_policy.note: ORIGIN is a deliberately stacked centre scene (tree printed across the moon, serpent behind the character): polygon occlusion is by design and overstates visual blocking. Numbers are recorded per piece in validation_report.json; composition acceptance is the vision-checked assembly preview against the supplied concept art. Structural checks (row clearance, overhang, load path, gaps) stay hard.
